reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a calendar page containing two lines of text, strongly signaling an agenda, schedule, itinerary, or calendar note. It fits tasks explicitly about calendars, schedules, and meeting agendas well, though it competes closely with other calendar variants and must not be overused for any task that merely has a due date or uses the verb 'schedule'.
